summary: Iteration 98 - Editable Rate Calendar & AI Copilot Voice Testing Complete. All 12 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: click-to-edit calendar, bulk edit mode, rate override API, AI Copilot voice button, all 19 Revenue tabs visible.

tests: PUT /api/revenue/rate-override/all - Sets custom rate (£250, £275, £225)
PUT /api/revenue/rate-override/all with null custom_rate - Removes override
GET /api/revenue/rate-calendar/all - Returns has_override and custom_rate fields
Rate calendar structure includes all required fields (days, performance, room_types)
Month navigation works (year/month parameters)
Bulk override simulation - 3 consecutive days set successfully
Click on day cell opens inline rate editor with input field
Inline editor shows save (green checkmark) and cancel (X) buttons
Saving rate shows toast notification 'Rate set to £225'
Custom rates displayed in amber color with original rate crossed out
Badge shows '1 custom rate' / '5 custom rates' count
'Click any day to set a custom rate' hint visible
Calendar navigation (prev/next month) works
View toggles (Prices/Occupancy/Pickup) work
Bulk Edit button toggles bulk mode
Bulk Edit bar appears with 'X days selected' counter
Clicking days in bulk mode selects them (checkmark visible)
Rate input field accepts value
'Apply to X days' button applies rate to all selected days
Toast notification 'Rate £175 applied to 3 days' shown
Cancel button exits bulk mode
Voice button visible with data-testid='rev-copilot-voice'
Voice button is enabled and clickable
Uses Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition)
Chat input and send button functional
Clear chat button works
AI responses display correctly

critical_code_review_comments: RateCalendarEditable.js well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Rate override API properly handles both set and remove operations
Bulk edit correctly iterates through selected days and applies rate
Voice input uses Web Speech API with proper error handling
Calendar shows clear visual distinction between custom rates (amber) and auto-priced (violet)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All editable calendar features working, voice button visible, all 19 tabs navigable)

seed_data_creation: Test rate overrides created during testing: April 25 (£225), April 26-28 (£175). Existing override on April 20 (£150) preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 98 tested the new Editable Rate Calendar (replacing read-only calendar) and AI Copilot voice input. Rate Calendar now supports: click-to-edit inline editor, bulk edit mode for multiple days, clear override button (X icon on hover). Rate override API: PUT /api/revenue/rate-override/{property_id} with {date, custom_rate, room_type_id}. Set custom_rate to null to remove override. Calendar shows overrides in amber with 'X custom rates' badge. Voice button uses Web Speech API (data-testid='rev-copilot-voice'). All 19 Revenue tabs working.

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real. Rate overrides stored in MongoDB rate_overrides collection. AI Copilot uses GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM Key.
